notes:
POC summary (short bullets):
- Target: interactive captioning + live assistant; p95 target <300ms for <=50 concurrent viewers per shard.
- Setup: Dedicated test cluster (2xA100 equiv), quantized Llama-variant, streaming enabled, 50 simulated concurrent streams.
- Results: p50 120-150ms (good), p95 ~1.1s-1.4s (missed target). Observed streaming behavior: initial chunks delivered quickly, but tailing tokens and follow-on messages experienced 600-1200ms stalls.
- Engineering notes: traces point at KV-cache churn + batching heuristics under high-concurrency simulation; continuous batching created long tail for some sessions. SE (Rafael) reproduced locally, proposed: reduce batch window, pin hot KV entries, tune kernel selection for short-seq streaming. Estimated dev effort: 4-6 weeks for validated patch + staging run.
- Security: Tidewater security team asked for audit-log retention SLA (12+ months), customer-managed KMS support, and explicit data residency for EU viewers. Redwood provided roadmap docs but no firm dates for audit-log SLA; security listed as gating item.
- Commercial/Org: VP Eng (primary champion) left Jan 2026; new Eng lead deprioritized project. Execs paused spend due to Q1 budget freeze. Streamly performed a quick demo promising <400ms p95 and won the proof-of-concept at pilot scope.
- Outcome: Sales marked account closed-lost 2026-02-28 (lost to Streamly + budget).
- Follow-ups: archive POC traces (INF-1138), save security FAQ responses, set reminder to re-open in Q3 if budgets reopen. Possible re-entry: Dedicated + Private deployment with targeted streaming optimizations; suggest joint perf workshop before re-engagement.
- Quote from customer (prod PM): "Streaming felt choppy at scale — viewer UX risk. We can't ship with inconsistent p95."
- Action items recorded: security docs uploaded to drive, perf trace bundle attached to INF-1138, SE retrospective completed 2026-02-25.
